_comment: Single current-state source of truth for CoreTend 0.8.1. Historical snapshots (Documentation/AuditHistory/**, project-state-audit.json, old session logs) keep their own original commit and are never updated to match this file. The 0.8.0 version of this file is frozen at Documentation/AuditHistory/0.8.0/CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE.json.
phase: 0.8.1 Final Canonical Audit Resync — documents, evidence and archives realigned with the real final state. No feature, design or architecture change. Nothing pushed, deployed, published, signed or notarized.

commits._comment: Three distinct identities. Collapsing them into one field is the specific failure this schema exists to prevent. finalRepositoryHead is self-referential and therefore recorded post-hoc in the audit package manifest — see note_finalRepositoryHead.
commits.note_PRODUCT_SOURCE_COMMIT: The commit whose tree the audited ZIP/DMG were built from. Verified, not assumed: the build ran with `git status --short` provably empty at this commit, Scripts/build-release.sh stamped this value into Release/latest.json from `git rev-parse HEAD`, and Scripts/test-release-manifest.sh confirmed sourceCommit == HEAD immediately afterwards. Sources/ last changed at 3b5dc73 and Tests/ at 139dc16, so the compiled code is identical from 3b5dc73 onward; Resources/Info.plist (the 0.8.1 version strings) last changed at dec47a1. An earlier build of these artifacts recorded sourceCommit 3b5dc73 because it ran while the 0.8.1 release changes were still uncommitted; that defect is recorded as DIST-003/RESYNC-003 and is what the clean-tree rebuild resolved.
commits.note_finalRepositoryHead: A commit cannot contain its own SHA. FINAL_REPOSITORY_HEAD is the commit that records the checksums of the artifacts built at PRODUCT_SOURCE_COMMIT, so it is necessarily one commit later. Its delta from PRODUCT_SOURCE_COMMIT is Release/latest.json, Release/SHA256SUMS and this note — records of the artifacts, never inputs to them. The authoritative value is written into AUDIT_PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json at the root of the external audit package, built from a staging directory after that commit exists. Recover it with `git rev-parse HEAD` on a clean tree. See Documentation/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md.
commits.note_auditPackageCommit: Equals finalRepositoryHead for this phase: the package is built from a verified-clean tree at the final commit.

repository.note_remotes: git remote -v returns nothing. No public repository exists yet — see Documentation/HUMAN_BLOCKERS.md.

tests.note_testCases: 274 is the number of @Test functions, which is what the Swift Testing summary line counts. One of them (binSbinUsrRejected in Tests/SafetyCoreTests/PathValidatorTests.swift) is parameterized over 4 arguments and runs as 4 test cases, so 278 cases execute in total. Coherence verified this phase: 274 @Test declarations == 274 executed tests, and 57 @Suite declarations == 57 executed suites.
tests.source: Documentation/test-inventory.json, regenerated by Scripts/generate-test-inventory.sh from a real run at 92cbd08 on 2026-07-25
tests.supersededValue: The 0.8.0 figure was 250 tests / 55 suites. That was correct for its own commit and is preserved in Documentation/AuditHistory/0.8.0/; it must not be reused here.

builds.note_warnings: Counted from real output: `swift build` and `swift build -c release` each emit zero lines matching 'warning:'. Warnings visible in older parts of Documentation/AUDIT_COMMANDS.log are from 0.8.0-era runs and are historical.

features.changeThisPhase: Grew 42 -> 46. The 0.8.0 inventory predated the rebrand and did not list the four features the rebrand actually delivered: migration.legacydata, migration.launchwiring, settings.migrationnotice, uninstall.legacydata. No pre-existing entry was altered.

artifacts.note_rebuilt: Rebuilt twice this phase, neither time discretionarily. First, Scripts/test-release-manifest.sh — a mandatory gate — calls Scripts/build-release.sh inside its own resync regression check. Second, and final, at the clean final tree so the artifacts have unambiguous provenance: `git status --short` was empty immediately before the build, and the release-manifest gate then confirmed sourceCommit == HEAD. ZIP/DMG output is not byte-reproducible, so hashes from earlier builds in this phase no longer correspond to any file on disk; only Release/SHA256SUMS is authoritative.
artifacts.note_hashes: Authoritative hashes live in Release/SHA256SUMS and Release/latest.json, and are duplicated into AUDIT_PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json / AUDIT_PACKAGE_SHA256SUMS at package time. They are deliberately not restated here, so this file can never disagree with them.

open: No trademark search has been run for the name CoreTend (Nice 9/42 across EUIPO, INPI, USPTO, UKIPO, WIPO) nor a prior-software-usage search
legalReviewStatus is 'pending' and publicReleaseAllowed is not true in Configuration/BrandRenameApproval.local.json (gitignored)
Legal identity undefined: publisher name, legal address, publisher of record
Security contact undefined — no monitored inbox or private reporting channel exists
Approval to create the public GitHub repository — irreversible, not given
Approval to push — irreversible, not given
Approval to deploy the website — irreversible, not given
Signing / notarization decision: no Apple Developer ID in use
Publication of a first public release

Module-targeted screenshot capture hits an intermittent AppleScript -1719; the full FR/EN x light/dark x every-module capture campaign is unrun. A plain launch capture does work — a real display is available, contrary to the older 'no display' claim.
DMG saved icon positions need Finder automation, which this environment refuses. The DMG is functional with its background and volume icon embedded.
Only one physical Mac (arm64, macOS 26.5.1) available: no multi-hardware or multi-macOS verification
No Xcode: ad-hoc signature only, no UI tests, no notarization
ClamAV not installed locally, so Protection reports itself honestly unavailable rather than scanning

gates.note_publication: Red on purpose, for the real human reasons listed in humanBlockers. Scripts/check-publish-readiness.sh fails on placeholder tokens, a missing Configuration/PublicIdentity.local.json, and an undefined security contact. Scripts/check-brand-clearance.sh --publication fails on the absent trademark search. Neither is run as a blocking step in normal CI.

defectsFoundAndFixedThisPhase: Scripts/check-legacy-brand-references.sh was RED at 92cbd08 — Documentation/AUDIT_COMMANDS.log and Documentation/CONTINUATION.md matched the pre-rename pattern with no allowlist entry. Both are legitimate (a raw evidence transcript and the rename record); allowlisted with stated reasons.

The same gate scanned case-sensitively and so missed a screaming-case leftover: a dead MACCARELOCAL_STORE_DIR export in Scripts/test-distribution.sh that nothing has ever read. The gate now scans case-insensitively; the dead export was deleted rather than renamed.
Scripts/test-distribution.sh claimed it 'never touches the real per-user Application Support location' while doing exactly that. Comment corrected.
Release/latest.json recorded a stale sourceCommit (3b5dc73) for artifacts whose contents matched dec47a1. Resolved by the gate-driven rebuild; sourceCommit now equals the real HEAD at build time.
Documentation/user-data-rename-migration.json still said status PLANNED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for a migration that had shipped and really run. Now DELIVERED_AND_EXECUTED with the journal evidence.

The pre-implementation migration design and test plan both opened by stating no migration code existed. Archived verbatim under Documentation/RebrandHistory/ with historical banners, superseded by Documentation/CORETEND_DATA_MIGRATION_REPORT.md.

Documentation/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md carried two stale entries: the repo-checkout-path string is no longer in the binary, and the 'no attached display' headline was already contradicted by its own later updates. Both corrected in place without deleting the history.
note: Regenerate the commit fields via Scripts/compute-audit-commits.sh --json before trusting this file after further commits. Be aware that script defines PRODUCT_SOURCE_COMMIT as the last commit touching Sources/ or Tests/, which answers a different question than 'which commit were the artifacts built from' — both are recorded above.
